features.name: Upgrade better-auth 1.6 -> 1.7.7
features.description: Bump better-auth, @better-auth/passkey and @better-auth/api-key to ^1.7.7 together in packages/auth, packages/ui and apps/web. Keep @better-auth-ui/* at 1.6.x (peer range allows better-auth >=1.6.19). Never target 1.7.0-1.7.2 (account.issuer migration); 1.7.3+ keeps the account schema unchanged. Steps: (1) read-only DB pre-check for duplicate (provider_id, account_id) rows and no issuer column; (2) bump; (3) fix type errors (usePlural now gives singular many-to-one relation keys); (4) regenerate the schema with the new `auth` CLI into a scratch file and diff with packages/database/src/schema/auth.sql.ts, expecting no table change (if a migration is needed, stop and ask); (5) switch auth:generate from the stale @better-auth/cli (1.4.21) to the `auth` package; (6) smoke test that createAuth() builds; (7) manual sign-in check with an existing user against a copy of the DB. No schema migration expected. Rollback is a revert if no schema change.
features.scope: packages/auth, apps/web/package.json, packages/ui/package.json, pnpm-lock.yaml, packages/database/src/schema/auth.sql.ts only if the diff requires it
features.evidence: 2026-10-10 devcontainer: ./init.sh --full passed (33 tests incl. createAuth smoke test). Local DB pre-check ok (no duplicate (provider_id, account_id), no issuer column, only credential accounts). `auth@1.7.7 generate` vs auth.sql.ts: no table/column changes (no DB migration); only relation keys users -> user. Hash check: 1.7 verifies 1.6 scrypt hashes and vice versa. Fixes: linked-account.tsx now passes account.id to accountInfo/unlinkAccount (1.7 identifies accounts by row id), typed resolvedUser in user-avatar/user-view, zod aligned to ^4.5.4 (dedupes zod), @better-auth/api-key and oauth-provider made direct deps at ^1.7.7, auth:generate now uses auth@1.7.7. User confirmed local sign-in with an existing user works. Settings/security pages and OAuth providers are not used (not in production either), so those paths are untested by design. Optional low-risk check before production deploy: the duplicate-account SQL on Neon (only credential accounts are expected).

features.name: Exclude vendored UI code from Biome

In packages/ui/biome.json exclude src/components, src/lib and src/hooks (today that is effectively all authored-by-others code in packages/ui/src; CSS is already excluded) and remove the five now-pointless per-file rule overrides. Remove the three `biome-ignore` comments added to packages/ui/src/components/chart.tsx. Keep tsc (`check-types`) coverage unchanged. Verify: `pnpm lint:ci` passes; a deliberately badly formatted/violating line in a vendored file (reverted afterwards) does not fail `lint:ci` and is not rewritten by `pnpm --filter @repo/ui lint`; apps/web and packages/auth are still linted (same check there fails). Document in CLAUDE.md invariants that packages/ui vendored code is not linted.
